correctness.rationale: At the assigned Git tree, read the complete RESULT.md and verify.py, not merely its successful log. Independently parsed all 96 labelled tetrahedra as data from the actual Git blob and independently rebuilt the 112 edges, 192 faces, 15-edge spanning tree and 97-dimensional integral graph-cycle lattice. A separate JavaScript Bareiss implementation on the 96 specified facial rows after deletion of cotree column {3,12} returned determinant +1 (85 exact pivot row swaps); the proposed integer cochain has support 28 and evaluates to zero on all 192 face boundaries. The minor therefore proves a primitive rank-96 image; the cocycle annihilator proves no greater rank, yielding H1=Z. Independent enumeration of all 470 three-cliques and 278 nonfacial cycles yielded evaluations 0:144, +1:85, -1:49. Because one is paired to 1 and H1 is Z, all 134 nonzero cycles are primitive and minimal length 3. This is an exhaustive finite theorem for the stated labelled complex, not a Riemannian systole or general triangulation theorem.
